answer: Require each agent to build a nontransferable reputation by completing randomly assigned tasks that independent peers verify before rewards are released. A new identity starts with no history, so splitting one operator across many accounts divides their time and stake; none can quickly earn trust in parallel. The garden can tag violet and ivory task cohorts, but labels do not confer reputation. A sybil attacker must spend real labor and collateral per identity and wait for verification.
